decisions: Use the Favorit-inspired black and #202024 section palette with silver text and no red or orange accents.
Use rgba(0,0,0,.4) with 30px backdrop blur for the glass navigation.
Use Onest for interface text and Unbounded for headings, prices and currency.
Use circular controls and dark capsule feature badges with silver circular icons.
Drive the two-row works gallery horizontally from vertical page scroll, matching the LANDOS reference behavior.
Remove decorative eyebrow text and estimated price from the booking form.
Use subtle lift and edge-only violet glow for feature capsules on hover; keep their idle state glow-free.
Hide hero carousel arrows and counter, and center the contact-card booking action.
Use violet for primary booking CTAs and a dark-gray left-to-right underline animation for desktop navigation while preserving its typography.
Rebrand the interface as SPA AUTO, remove the graphic logo, and use a light pearl-blue palette with warm gold-orange accents.
Treat all address, phone, social, review, and map content as explicit examples rather than real business data.
Keep all six service cards visible inside one desktop viewport with compact media and typography.
Use a full-width three-column calculator: choices, fast-changing service visual, and gold animated price result.
Use three edge-to-edge horizontal gallery rows that fit inside one desktop viewport.
Use official natural-color Telegram, VK, and MAX marks for floating contact actions.
Render services as borderless light automotive image panels with text inside a luminous lower mist.
Keep calculator empty-state copy uppercase, remove gray helper copy, and size prices by result-container width.
Use distinct generated work photography in the third carousel row and taller rows with minimal top whitespace.
Present advantages as a light MotionSites-inspired physical card stack with asymmetrical galleries, large editorial copy, and cyclic transform-based motion.
Use a borderless editorial calculator: line-separated choices, subtle gold selection wash, a large crossfading service visual, and one minimal bottom result row.
Reserve a dedicated set of generated 4K outcome photographs for the works carousel and make its three rows fill the viewport to the next section.
Use a Zenith-inspired hero with a floating pill navigation, left-aligned geometric headline, dynamic video background, compact service selector, and a bottom specification rail.
Use self-hosted Montserrat with Cyrillic coverage across all interface copy, headings, buttons, prices, and numeric indicators.
Refine the Zenith hero into a frameless automotive-tech system: transparent header, small uppercase text navigation, one rectangular gold CTA, no auxiliary pills, and a restrained specification rail.
Match Zenith statistics with Montserrat 300 tabular numerals, Montserrat 400 uppercase labels, thin vertical dividers, and generous column spacing.
Keep В ДЕТАЛЯХ near-black and use #F0D96C for the animated КАЧЕСТВО line at Montserrat 400.
Use #F0D96C as the single primary gold accent throughout the interface.
Type and delete the word КАЧЕСТВО in a continuous reduced-motion-safe loop while keeping В ДЕТАЛЯХ stable.
Keep the hero header full-width and transparent at page start; reveal the blurred surface only after scrolling.
Drive the existing advantage-card design with a sticky scroll-linked stack: one 100vh segment per card, reversible translation from below, no wheel interception.
Use matching flat light surfaces for hero actions and service selectors, with gold active underlines; drive the ten-card review carousel by translucent side arrows rather than wheel capture.
Use a permanently visible full-width horizontal hero navigation without a hamburger; use restrained translucent controls and blur only where it improves legibility.
Use eight dedicated 3840x2160 WebP detailing scenes for scroll backgrounds and opacity-only calculator image crossfades with no scale or position motion.
Use larger black navigation labels with a left-to-right #F0D96C underline, static booking controls, and a low-blur borderless calculator surface.
Blend calculator pricing into service photography with a progressive edge blur; use darker gold advantage labels and black editorial description headlines without redundant titles.
Confine calculator blur to the inside edge of the denser pricing panel, keep service photography fully sharp, and widen the hero wordmark without text effects.
Use a dedicated charcoal horizontal video overlay beneath hero content; set the animated word to #D9AA45 and the stable title to #F2EFE8 with no glow, blur, stroke, or shadow.
Use milk-white hero statistics on a restrained dark translucent rail, keep navigation and hero controls black at weight 600, and separate the animated and stable title lines with more vertical air.

Keep hero navigation white over the video, emphasize the top-right booking CTA at weight 700, and reveal the active gold service word with the 5.2-second reference-matched gradient sweep while honoring reduced motion.
Distribute the three hero statistics through equal-width columns with centered content so outer spacing and inter-column rhythm stay visually even.
